brand.name: EVIDENT (Project Experience Platform)
brand.mission: Replace 'I don't have experience' with verifiable proof of real project execution.
brand.theme_preference: Light theme primary (Clean, open, trustworthy) with optional dark mode for workspaces.
anti_patterns: No online course/LMS visual cliches (avoid graduation caps, generic checkmarks).
No excessive gradients, childish illustrations, or fake metrics.
No generic 'Bootstrap-style' UI cards with heavy drop shadows.

secondary_font.usage: Body text, UI elements, data tables, forms

rules: Tinted Grey Rule: Greys should lean slightly cool (Slate/Zinc) to feel professional.
High Contrast Focus: Primary CTAs are solid Slate-900 (almost black) with white text, not standard blue.
Use Accent color (Blue) exclusively for active states, links, and verification badges.
Hover states must have explicitly defined text colors (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).

surfaces.cards: Flat & Crisp: bg-white border border-zinc-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm (No heavy drop shadows)
surfaces.modals: Solid white with subtle dimming backdrop (bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-sm)

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp borders (border-zinc-200) everywhere to create structure without visual weight.

marketing_page.spacing: Generous: py-24 to py-32 between sections
marketing_page.hero: Asymmetric Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8) or massive typography with high-quality imagery.

dashboard.layout: Collapsible left sidebar + top bar structure.
dashboard.spacing: High density: p-4 to p-8 padding for content areas.
dashboard.widgets: Top-left prioritized. Key metric gets col-span-2 or col-span-full on mobile.

grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text and forms. Center-align only for short hero headlines or zero-state empty screens.
grids_and_layouts.technical: Grid items must be direct children. Use display: grid.

component_rules.buttons: Rectangular with subtle rounding (rounded-md). Strict interaction states (hover, focus ring, active scale).
component_rules.inputs: Shadcn UI inputs. 1px border. Focus state must use ring-2 ring-slate-900 or brand-accent ring-offset-2.
component_rules.cards: Avoid default card styling. Use cardless or highly minimal bounding boxes (border-zinc-200).
component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Checkbox. NO native select elements.
component_rules.tables: Dense, left-aligned, border-b only for rows (no vertical borders). Stick to text-sm.
forbidden_html: Transparent headers (Always use blur or solid background over content)

motion.hover_states: Buttons and cards translate-y-[1px] or subtly change border/background color.
motion.interactive: Use sonner for instant toast feedback.

accessibility.contrast: Text must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large text).
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings.
accessibility.testing: MANDATORY: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='enroll-button', data-testid='submit-project').

media_and_images.rules: No placeholder images. Use direct URLs from the curated list. Use object-cover for hero backgrounds with a maximum black/30 or white/40 overlay.

hero_student_working.description: Student in headphones working intensely on a laptop, perfect for hero section or 'Build' feature block.

project_architecture.description: Modern architect drafting table. Use as a metaphor for 'Project Workspace' or 'Building Real Products'.

professional_portfolio.description: Minimal professional office desk with an iMac. Good for showcasing the 'Evidence/Portfolio' outcome.

3d_libraries.strategy: Not recommended for this specific professional use-case unless required for a specific marketing graphic. Rely on high-quality typography and 2D geometry.
3d_libraries.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn charts) for admin analytics and student progress.

instructions_to_main_agent.1_setup: Install lucide-react, sonner, and tailwind-merge. Setup Shadcn UI components.
instructions_to_main_agent.2_routing: Implement marketing page (/), student dashboard (/dashboard), and admin dashboard (/admin).
instructions_to_main_agent.3_execution: Follow exact colors, typography, and spacing from this document. Apply data-testid to everything.
instructions_to_main_agent.4_forms: Build the enrollment checkout and project submission flows using Shadcn forms.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold: make the UI feel like a premium career tool (think Linear, Vercel, or modern fintech) rather than a cheap LMS.
Do not apply 'transition: all' in CSS. Target specific transitions.
NEVER center-align the main App container. Respect natural reading flow.
NEVER use emojis as UI icons. Use lucide-react exclusively.
Always use the provided Unsplash URLs. Never use generic placeholder text or dummyimage.com.
Prioritize Shadcn components over custom HTML for interactive elements.
Ensure every page has a visible navigation bar and standard footer.
Use sonner for all application toasts (success/error states).
MANDATORY: Add data-testid attributes to ALL buttons, inputs, links, and actionable items.
MANDATORY: Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on headers or dropdowns that overlay content.
